rule:
LOGIC PATH when a job fails (this is how the teacher fixes — copy the procedure, not the outcome).

STEP 0 — Classify (do not act yet)
  Read artifacts/host_agent_last_job.json + any scoreboard_*.json written by the job.
  Extract: ok, reason (max_steps|assert|timeout|exception), score, mutation names that failed, n_steps used.

STEP 1 — Hypothesis table (pick ONE)
  A. Budget too low: same mutation never reached a decisive state at low steps, and a higher budget has NOT been measured yet.
  B. Budget ruled out: two runs at different max_steps both end reason=max_steps / same failing set → do NOT raise steps again.
  C. Tool/order gap: agent may write before read, or never call the tool that reveals the bug → test --read-first or forced tool order.
  D. Repair quality: agent sees the bug but produces a weak patch → change decide/prompt, not budget.
  E. Infra: docker/ollama/path/timeout_infra → fix host, NEVER record as code FAIL.

STEP 2 — Smallest honest experiment
  One mutation. One new job id. One controlled change (only the hypothesis under test).
  Prefer: --trace + scoreboard path that lands on origin.
  Timeout must be high enough that the experiment finishes; partial scoreboards must still push.

STEP 3 — After the experiment lands
  Re-read scoreboard + trace yourself from GitHub.
  If hypothesis confirmed: write a durable lesson (no self-matching enqueue).
  If hypothesis falsified: return to STEP 1 with a different letter.
  NEVER auto-chain playbook recoveries. NEVER match on note starting with playbook: or id containing diag_after_.

STEP 4 — Preference / ML signal
  When a clean scoreboard lands, record preference pairs (pass > fail, higher verification preferred).
  Mirror strategy_stats under artifacts/ so the host and teacher can both see boosts.

This path is the training data. Outcome alone is not enough — the sequence of decisions is what the agent must internalize.
